title: Remove a teacher from your school

steps.say: **Remove** on a teacher's row takes them off your school when they leave. Their own account survives — what goes is their place here and their view of its classes and learners.
You are asked for their name back before anything happens, so a mistaken tap costs you nothing. Confirm and the list refreshes without them.
An admin's row carries no **Remove** button at all, so a school can never lose its own admin through this list. Change their role first if that is really what you want.
steps.terminal: That's a leaver off your staff list, their own account untouched. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
